en: Danball Senki Plastic Model Premium Bandai limited LBX Hakaiger!
The mass-produced version of Goda's LBX Hakaio "Hakaiger" is finally here! !
Don't miss out on the limited color Hakaiger! !
• The powerful coloring that appears in the movie is faithfully reproduced with molded colors.
• Includes a large sword “Haganjin”
Assembly type platform model
Target age: 6 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
No glue used for assembly
Molded products, foil seal
